name: OpenSSH client
summary: Foreground service guidance for OpenSSH client, with reviewed descriptor suggestions.

advisories.message: For persistent forwarding use a foreground -N invocation without -f, with BatchMode=yes, ExitOnForwardFailure=yes and reviewed ServerAliveInterval/ServerAliveCountMax. Finite remote commands need --restart no.

Use the intended account and verified host keys. Agent sockets may not survive logout or reboot. Arbitrary SSH builds, proxy commands and remote-command modes do not justify automatic high descriptor limits.
The 65536 descriptor pair is a suggestion only. Accept it only after verifying the build supports high descriptors; otherwise retain inherited limits.

The existing on-failure restart policy and delay remain in effect unless explicitly changed. Finite commands need --restart no; long-running modes still need application health and capacity monitoring.
Basename matching does not authenticate the executable, version or build. Preserve the original arguments, working directory and explicit user choices.
